description: This Java class 'DatatableExportUtil' provides utility methods for generating and normalizing filenames for data export, including handling folder names, report filenames, and timestamp appending, with validation and string normalization.

classes.name: DatatableExportUtil
classes.description: A utility class for generating normalized and timestamped filenames for data export, with methods for folder normalization, filename generation, and validation.

methods.name: normalizeFolderName
methods.description: Normalizes folder names by trimming, replacing special characters with underscores, collapsing multiple slashes, and removing leading dots or slashes.

methods.name: generatePlainExportFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for export with a specified maximum length, extension, report name, and parameters.

methods.name: generateS3DatatableExportFileName
methods.description: Generates an S3-compatible filename with folder, extension, report name, and parameters, ensuring length constraints.

methods.name: generateReportFileName
methods.description: Creates a timestamped report filename, normalizing the report name and appending parameters, respecting maximum length.

methods.name: extractReportParameterKey
methods.description: Extracts the key from report parameter strings, removing surrounding '${' and '}'.
